html:
Top 10 festivals taking place in Da Nang will bring you the feeling of autumn during the holidays, in the coastal city of Central Vietnam.

When talking about Da Nang festivals, you cannot help but mention the fireworks festival, street festival, village festival, boat racing festival… so let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the special festivals taking place in Da Nang during the year right below.

Da Nang International Fireworks Festival

This is one of the big festivals, often taking place during holidays or major events of the year, with many exciting programs taking place on the banks of the Han River.

In addition, there are many big activities such as: Art exhibitions, culinary festivals, or big music nights, visitors will be melodious with the music, if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang at this time, visitors will immerse themselves in the exciting festival in the coastal city.

Quan The Am Festival

The festival usually takes place in early spring, that is, in the second lunar month every year. This is also an occasion to attract people and tourists from all over to attend at the Ngu Hanh Son scenic area. The festival is also an occasion for everyone to show their respect and pray for a new year of peace, happiness, favorable weather, and bountiful harvests.

In addition to the festival, visitors can also participate in many interesting games such as: sports-cultural activities, folk games such as throwing con, singing tuong, sculpture, releasing flower lanterns, etc.

Cau Ngu Festival

The festival usually takes place on January 14 every year, demonstrating the culture of fishermen in coastal areas. The festival includes traditional rituals and folk games, cultural arts, and sports…

An Hai Village Festival

The festival usually takes place in An Hai Tay Ward, Son Tra District, the festival lasts for 1 week. The festival includes the parasol procession, flag procession… and the four sacred animals boat race, visitors will join the locals in cheering.

Shepherd Procession Festival

As one of the festivals that many tourists visit, the festival usually takes place in the third lunar month every year, visitors coming here can not only worship the village’s mascot but also admire the innocent boys and girls playing in the fields.

Tuy Loan Village Festival

The festival takes place at Tuy Loan village communal house, the festival takes place in January, the festival includes the procession of royal decrees, offering incense to the communal house to commemorate the ancestors who founded Tuy Loan village. Coming to Da Nang tour during the festival, visitors can also participate in folk cultural games such as: Banh Tet wrapping competition, tug of war, bamboo pole dancing, …

Hoa My Village Festival

The festival usually takes place on January 12 every year, including rituals and traditional culture of the village, the festival also has folk games such as: Hoa My Village Festival, flower arrangement competition, health exercises for the elderly …

Boat racing festival

Usually takes place in January every year, with participating teams from all neighboring provinces of the Central region, on dragon boats decorated very eye-catching, in the cheers of the people and tourists will bring tourists the most interesting vacation in Da Nang.

Festivals in Ba Na Hills

Ba Na is the place where many exciting festival events take place such as: Flower Festival, Carnival, Winter Festival… and many more attractive festivals are waiting for visitors to discover.

Street Festival

Usually taking place in the summer, coming here on this occasion, visitors can also join in the atmosphere of the festival, dress up as famous characters and enjoy the melodious music, which will bring visitors an interesting vacation in Da Nang city.
